name: Hyoka – Product Reviews, Customer Reviews, Photo Reviews & Testimonials for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Most WooCommerce customers never leave a review unless you ask them at the right time and make it effortless. Yet new shoppers rely on star ratings, real buyer photos, unboxing videos, and honest customer testimonials before they feel safe enough to buy.

Hyoka is a complete WooCommerce product reviews, photo and video reviews, store testimonials, customer Q&A, and loyalty coupons plugin. It automatically follows up after completed orders, rewards shoppers with discount coupons, displays reviews in fast storefront widgets, and tracks your results in a visual analytics dashboard, all from your own WordPress admin panel.

Unlike outside SaaS platforms that charge monthly fees and lock away your reviews, Hyoka runs natively inside WordPress. There is no limit on how many reviews you can collect, and your customer data always stays on your own server.

Try the Live Demo | Explore All Features | Pricing & Plans | Documentation | Get Support

Why WooCommerce Store Owners Switch to Hyoka

  • Automated Review Request Emails: Send personalized review invitations automatically after an order is completed, with smart setup modals that guide you in enabling the right email templates.
  • Photo & Video Reviews: Let buyers attach real product pictures and video clips straight from their phones.
  • Storefront Widgets With Live Previews: Display review grids, video carousels, sliders, trust badges, and a flexible Floating Bar, and customize them with interactive previews before publishing.
  • Verified & Level-Up Badges: Build buyer confidence with Verified Purchase and Verified Review badges, plus level-up badges that recognize store milestones and active reviewers.
  • Reviews Analytics Dashboard & Reports: Track review velocity, average star ratings over time, photo and video submission rates, email open and click rates, and how reviews impact sales conversions.
  • CSV/PDF Exports & Scheduled Admin Reports: Download your review analytics in CSV or PDF format anytime, or set up automated weekly and monthly email reports for store administrators.
  • Built-In AI Review Assistant: Automatically tag review sentiment, summarize long feedback, draft replies in one click, and block spam before it goes live.
  • Review for Discount & Referral Program: Send automatic WooCommerce discount coupons when customers leave a review, offer bonus rewards for photo and video uploads, and let shoppers share referral links.
  • Product Page Customer Q&A: Answer shopper questions right on the product page with threaded community replies so visitors do not abandon their carts.
  • Easy 1-Click Review Importer: Move your existing product and store reviews in from Amazon, AliExpress, Judge.me, Yotpo, or CSV using a clean, step-by-step import screen.
  • Google Rich Snippets & Review SEO: Automatically add JSON-LD schema markup and XML review sitemaps so your product star ratings appear in Google search results.
  • Marketing & CRM Integrations: Connect your review workflow with Mailchimp, Klaviyo, FluentCRM, Zapier/Webhooks, and Twilio SMS.

How Automated Review Request Emails Work

Chasing customers manually for feedback takes too much time. Hyoka handles your entire post-purchase review follow-up automatically:

  1. A customer places an order in your WooCommerce store.
  2. You mark the order as completed once it is delivered or shipped.
  3. After the number of days you choose, Hyoka automatically sends a branded email or SMS inviting the customer to review their purchase.
  4. The customer selects a star rating, writes their feedback, and uploads photos or videos inside one simple mobile-friendly form.

Built to get you more responses with less effort:

  • One form for multi-item orders: If a customer buys 3 products in one order, they get a single combined form to review all 3 items instead of 3 separate emails.
  • Guided template setup: Smart recommendation modals alert you if a required email template is turned off when enabling automation, so your workflow always runs smoothly.
  • Automatic follow-ups and photo reminders: Send one polite reminder if a buyer misses your first email, or send a follow-up asking if they want to add a photo to a text-only review.
  • Visual email customizer: Match your review emails to your store’s logo, colors, and fonts, and send yourself a test email before turning campaigns live.

Display High-Converting Social Proof Anywhere on Your Site

Hyoka gives you flexible widgets and Gutenberg blocks that match your theme and load only on the pages where you use them:

  • Product Reviews & Store Testimonials: Collect product-specific reviews on product pages alongside overall store testimonials that highlight your brand reputation.
  • Interactive Widget Previews: Test and customize colors, layouts, and display rules inside a live preview screen before publishing widgets to your storefront.
  • Enhanced Floating Bar & Trust Badges: Show both product reviews and store reviews in a floating bar with flexible positioning, or place verified rating badges anywhere on your site.
  • Video Carousels & Photo Lightboxes: Let shoppers watch smooth customer video clips and browse real unboxing photos in clean popup galleries.
  • Verified Purchase & Achievement Badges: Clearly mark real buyers with Verified Purchase and Verified Review badges, and keep customers engaged with level-up milestone badges.
  • Helpful Filtering & Visitor Replies: Shoppers can filter reviews by star rating, media, or helpfulness votes, and join threaded discussions.

Track Performance With the Reviews Analytics Dashboard

Instead of guessing whether your review requests are working, Hyoka gives you a dedicated Reviews Analytics Dashboard with clear visual charts:

  • Review Velocity & Rating Trends: See how many new reviews you are collecting each week and watch how your average star rating changes over time.
  • Photo & Video Submission Rates: Track what percentage of reviewers are attaching customer photos and videos.
  • Email Open & Click-Through Rates: Measure how well your review request and reminder emails are performing.
  • Review-to-Conversion Correlation: Understand how customer reviews and ratings connect to your store’s sales performance.
  • CSV & PDF Report Exports: Export your analytics data as a CSV spreadsheet or a formatted PDF report in one click.
  • Scheduled Weekly & Monthly Email Summaries: Have Hyoka automatically email a performance digest to store administrators every week or month.

Save Time With Built-In AI & Dark Mode Moderation

Managing customer feedback is fast and comfortable, even as your store grows:

  • AI Sentiment Analysis: Automatically labels incoming reviews as positive, neutral, or negative so you can spot happy buyers or issues right away.
  • AI Smart Replies: Generate a polite, natural reply draft for any review in one click.
  • AI Review Summaries: Condense dozens of long customer reviews into a few clear bullet points at the top of your review section.
  • AI Spam Protection: Block fake reviews, bots, and profanity automatically before they appear on your product pages.
  • Full Dark Mode Interface: Moderate product reviews, store reviews, and visitor replies in a clean dashboard with built-in light and dark mode.

Turn Reviewers Into Repeat Buyers With Coupons & Referrals

Getting a first-time buyer to place a second order is one of the fastest ways to grow your WooCommerce revenue:

  • Automatic Review Discount Coupons: Email a discount code immediately after a customer submits a review.
  • Bonus Coupons for Photo & Video Reviews: Offer a bigger discount when a shopper includes a real photo or video clip with their review.
  • Honest Reward Rules: Coupons are sent for leaving genuine feedback regardless of the star rating, keeping your reviews authentic and trustworthy.
  • Coupon Expiry Reminders: Automatically remind customers before their reward coupon expires so they come back and use it.
  • Customer Referral Program: Give shoppers a personal referral link via widgets or shortcodes so they can invite friends and earn rewards.

Close More Sales With Product Page Q&A & Review SEO

  • Dedicated Customer Q&A Section: Let hesitant shoppers ask questions directly on product pages (or through a popup Q&A widget) and receive instant email notifications when you or another customer replies.
  • Redesigned SEO & Visibility Controls: Easily configure Google Rich Snippets (Product and AggregateRating JSON-LD schema) from a clean settings screen so your star ratings show up in Google search results.
  • SEO-Friendly Review Pages & XML Sitemaps: Automatically create indexable “All Reviews” pages and add them to your XML sitemap, fully compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO.

Migrate From Any Platform in Minutes

Switching to Hyoka does not mean starting from zero. The redesigned Imports page makes it simple to bring your existing social proof with you:

  • Import product reviews directly from Amazon and AliExpress
  • Migrate your full review history in one click from Judge.me, Yotpo, or CSV files
  • Export and import product reviews, store testimonials, customer Q&A, star ratings, dates, and photo/video attachments

Ready to see how Hyoka looks on a real store? Explore the live demo, browse the complete feature list, or check the setup documentation.

Blocks

This plugin provides 3 optimized blocks for easy visual placement:

  • Reviews Grid: A clean grid layout for displaying product reviews and store testimonials.
  • Trust Badge: A compact summary badge of your product and store ratings that you can place anywhere on your site.
  • Reviews Slider: A smooth, swipeable slider for highlighting top customer testimonials, photos, and videos.
sections.installation:
Minimum System Requirements

  • WordPress 5.3 or higher
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Hyoka.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Open Hyoka from your admin menu to set up your review widgets, automated emails, and analytics.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from your account.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and open Hyoka in your admin menu.

After Installation

Follow the step-by-step guides in the Hyoka documentation, test a pre-configured store in the live demo, or contact Hyoka support if you need help with your setup.
sections.faq:
Is Hyoka a SaaS platform or a native WordPress plugin?

Hyoka is a 100% native WordPress and WooCommerce plugin. Your reviews, photos, videos, and analytics stay on your own server. There is no monthly subscription fee and no limit on how many customer reviews you can collect. Learn more on the Hyoka website.

What can I track in the Reviews Analytics Dashboard?

The Reviews Analytics Dashboard shows your review velocity, average star ratings over time, photo and video submission rates, review email open and click rates, and how reviews correlate with store conversions. You can also export reports as CSV or PDF files and schedule weekly or monthly email reports for administrators.

Can I migrate my existing reviews from Judge.me, Yotpo, Amazon, AliExpress, or CSV?

Yes. Hyoka’s updated importer lets you bring in existing product and store reviews from Amazon, AliExpress, Judge.me, Yotpo, or custom CSV spreadsheets while keeping your star ratings, dates, and photo or video attachments intact. See the documentation for migration steps.

Can I preview and customize widgets before publishing them on my store?

Yes. Hyoka includes interactive widget previews right inside your dashboard so you can adjust layouts, colors, badges, and positioning options and see how everything looks before making it live on your storefront.

How do Verified Badges and Level-Up Badges work?

Hyoka displays Verified Purchase and Verified Review badges on reviews to show shoppers that feedback comes from real customers. It also includes level-up badges for stores and reviews to celebrate milestones and encourage repeat participation.

Does the plugin have a dark mode option?

Yes. Hyoka includes a built-in dark mode across the entire plugin dashboard for a comfortable viewing experience while you moderate reviews, check analytics, and adjust settings.

Does Hyoka integrate with Zapier, Klaviyo, FluentCRM, Mailchimp, or Twilio?

Yes. Hyoka connects directly with Zapier/Webhooks, Klaviyo, FluentCRM, Mailchimp lead sync, and Twilio SMS so you can automate your review invitations and marketing workflows.

How do automated review request emails work?

Once an order is marked “Completed” in WooCommerce, Hyoka waits the number of days you set and automatically emails the customer a link to a mobile-friendly review form. Built-in recommendation modals also guide you to make sure the required email templates are enabled when you turn on automation.

How do the built-in AI review tools work?

AI sentiment analysis, review summaries, smart reply drafts, and spam filtering are built right into your WordPress dashboard to help you manage reviews faster. You can view all features and plan options on the pricing and plans page.

Will Hyoka slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Review scripts load only on the pages where your review widgets actually appear, so the rest of your store, including checkout, stays fast.

Do customers get a coupon even if they leave a negative review?

Yes. Coupon rewards are sent for submitting an honest review rather than requiring a specific star rating, which keeps your reviews trustworthy. You can also offer bonus coupon rewards when customers attach photos or videos.

Does Hyoka support Google Rich Snippets and XML sitemaps for reviews?

Yes. From the SEO & Visibility settings page, Hyoka automatically outputs Google-compliant JSON-LD structured data (Product and AggregateRating schema) so your star ratings can appear in Google search results, and adds your review pages to your XML sitemap (compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO).

Can I show a popup or floating review widget instead of only a page section?

Yes. Hyoka includes an enhanced Floating Bar (with flexible positioning and support for both product reviews and store reviews), Trust Badges, and Popup Review Widgets alongside standard page widgets. Try them on the live demo.

Where can I find documentation and support?

Setup guides and feature walkthroughs are available in the Hyoka documentation. If you need help, visit the Hyoka support page to contact our team.
